description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller named RelatedItemsController, which manages related product items in an e-commerce admin interface. It includes methods for displaying related items, paging through related items, adding, and removing related product relationships. The class interacts with services for products, categories, and relationships, and enforces role-based security. The file is part of an administrative module for managing product relationships in a catalog.

classes.name: RelatedItemsController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing related product items in the admin panel. Handles displaying, paging, adding, and removing related items, with role-based access control.

methods.name: displayRelatedItems
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show the related items page for a specific product, verifying the product belongs to the current merchant store and preparing the model for view rendering.

methods.name: pageRelatedItems
methods.description: Processes POST requests to retrieve a paginated list of related items for a product, returning data as JSON. Validates product ownership and handles errors.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Processes POST requests to add a related product relationship between two products, verifying ownership and updating the relationship via service.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Processes POST requests to remove a related product relationship, with validation and service invocation.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the menu context for the views, indicating the active menu items.
